hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that takes over all ETH/MiniBTC swaps via BeforeSwapDelta: buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve and sells burn MiniBTC via an inverse curve priced against accumulated ETH reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently disabled. Requires hookData encoding the swapper address; enforces a block-number cooldown between a wallet's last buy and its first sell.
